channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Festival de Frue offers an antidote to Japan’s samey music festivals
item.description: The small-scale music festival has carved out its own identity without relying on deep-pocketed sponsors or pandering to the algorithm.

item.title: Japan eyes using Indian test ranges for powerful missiles and small attack drones
item.description: Tokyo sent officials to the South Asian nation this month as it eyes the possibility of using the sites, the GSDF's top uniformed officer said.

item.title: Japan’s UA Zensen union seeks 6% pay hike in 2027 wage talks
item.description: One of Japan's largest labor union groups plans to seek increases in line with this year's target, signaling sustained pressure for higher salaries.

item.title: Former senior Osaka prosecutor changes plea in sexual assault case to not guilty
item.description: The focus of the trial is expected to shift to whether the woman was unable to resist and whether Kentaro Kitagawa acted with criminal intent.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
